component.name: Categorized ToDo
component.summary: Categorized tasks with Jira and GitHub Projects integration

description.p: A GTK 4 / libadwaita desktop task manager with three modes: a local categorized ToDo list (optionally two-way synced with Notion), a read-only Jira issues view, and a read-only GitHub Projects (V2) view.

It runs both as a full window and as a small tray popup opened from a top-bar StatusNotifierItem icon. Closing the window keeps the app running in the background; quit from the tray icon's right-click menu.
